name: Iron Deity
look: a towering white robot Arceus before a golden halo, its armour split into spiked navy plates on one side and starry lilac plates with a folded fan of blades on the other
entry: A Pokémon resembling Arceus, recorded in a report about a machine that stood at the heart of the End and claimed to have built the world. Its halo turns slowly, keeping the cosmos in order.
how: Wild: very rare on the End's main island.
